lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform in the midsection with increased density and shortened length observed toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most and posterior-most segments appear as truncated dashes that do not fully traverse the vertical height of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots observed on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch exhibit a horizontal geometric alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the eyes and a distinct white horizontal patch on the ventral throat region.
